content: Responsive integration strategy for an existing desktop-first client-routed SPA: CSS-only media queries / container queries are the default tool for layout reflow (no layout shift, no JS dependency, mobile-first min-width variants); JS-driven switching via a useSyncExternalStore+matchMedia hook is needed only where the mounted component TREE itself must differ (swapping shell chrome such as sidebar vs bottom bar), because CSS cannot unmount components — display:none keeps both branches mounted, running their hooks/effects and duplicating DOM; route-level splits (separate mobile route trees) multiply the parity surface and break the single-URL contract. Recommended hybrid: one media-query hook at the Layout level for chrome mounting, CSS-first for everything inside pages. matchMedia reads synchronously at first render so the correct chrome paints without FOUC.
